name: ecommerce-product-listing
context: Design a product listing page for an ecommerce platform. The audience is online shoppers browsing products who need to quickly scan, filter, compare, and add items to cart. Target platforms: desktop, tablet, and mobile. The layout must optimize for product discovery with clear pricing, imagery, and quick-action patterns.
constraints: All visual values must reference Design_Token (no raw hex, px, or rem values)
Follow typography.rules.json for price and label hierarchy
Apply color.rules.json: use feedback tokens for sale/discount indicators
Grid layout must adapt from multi-column (desktop) to single-column (mobile) per layout.rules.json
Product images must maintain consistent aspect ratio using token-based sizing
Interactive elements (add to cart, wishlist) require all documented states
Comply with Quality_Gate: no visual hierarchy violations, proper token usage throughout

outputCriteria.format: Page layout spec with product card component, filter sidebar, and grid system using token references
qualityChecks: Product cards use consistent token-based spacing and radius
Price typography follows scale hierarchy from typography.rules.json
Filter controls use form component tokens for consistency
All interactive states (hover, focus, active, disabled) documented
accessibilityRequirements: Product images have descriptive alt text
Price information is programmatically associated with product name
Filter controls are keyboard operable and properly labeled
Add to cart buttons have accessible names identifying the product
Focus management maintained during filter updates without losing user position

examples.description: Product card molecule with image, title, price, and quick-add action
examples.output:
Molecule: ProductCard
  Layout: flex(direction=column)
  bg: var(--color-surface-primary)
  radius: var(--radius-md)
  shadow: var(--shadow-sm)
  overflow: hidden
  Children:
    - Atom: Image(aspectRatio=4/3, objectFit=cover, alt='{product.name}')
    - Container(padding: var(--space-md))
        - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.md, color=color.text.primary) -> product.name
        - Atom: Text(token=typography.heading.sm, color=color.text.primary) -> product.price
        - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.sm, color=color.feedback.success) -> product.discount (conditional)
        - Atom: Button(variant=primary, size=sm, ariaLabel='Add {product.name} to cart')
  States:
    hover: shadow(var(--shadow-md)), translateY(-2px) via state-transition preset
    focus-within: outline(var(--color-focus-ring))
acceptanceCriteria: All visual values use semantic token references
Hover state uses Motion_Library state-transition preset
Accessible labels include product name for screen readers
Discount color uses feedback semantic token
Card follows atomic design molecule pattern
